lines.en: Pip Health
lines.zh: 血条分格

lines.en: Standardized rules for units that take a fixed number of hits to destroy and unified the terminology
lines.zh: 为需要固定攻击次数才能摧毁的单位统一了规则，并统一了相关术语

lines.en: All units are now able to damage units with health bar pips
lines.zh: 现在所有单位都可以对带有分格血条的单位造成伤害

lines.en: Attacks from heroes, Roshan, towers, and the fountain deal 1 full pip per attack
lines.zh: 英雄、肉山、防御塔和泉水的攻击每次造成1格完整伤害

lines.en: Spell Mechanics
lines.zh: 技能机制

lines.en: Leashes that do not expressly pierce debuff immunity (such as Slark's Pounce) will no longer prevent movement-based abilities from being executed
lines.zh: 未明确无视减益免疫的束缚效果（例如斯拉克的突袭）将不再阻止位移类技能的释放

lines.en: Abilities that pierce debuff immunity no longer ignore the magic resistance provided by debuff immunity
lines.zh: 无视减益免疫的技能不再无视减益免疫提供的魔法抗性

lines.en: Spell Lifesteal from multiple copies of the same item now stack additively (e.g. two Voodoo Masks will provide +30%)
lines.zh: 多件同个物品的技能吸血现在加法叠加（如两个巫毒面具会提供+30%）

lines.en: Breakability rules of many innates updated
lines.zh: 多个先天技能的破坏规则已更新

lines.en: Specifics for this changes can be found in the corresponding ability notes
lines.zh: 有关这些改动的具体内容，请参阅相应的技能说明

lines.en: Spell Power Reduction
lines.zh: 法术强度降低

lines.en: Decreased most item contributions to ability scaling, including Spell Amplification, Area of Effect, and Cast Range
lines.zh: 减少了大部分物品对技能增幅的贡献，包括技能增强、作用范围和施法距离

lines.en: Decreased damage of the majority of Magic and Pure damage spells
lines.zh: 减少了大多数魔法和纯粹伤害技能的伤害

lines.en: Decreased duration of some long duration slows
lines.zh: 减少了部分长时间减速的持续时间

lines.en: Specifics for any of these changes can be found in the corresponding ability or item notes
lines.zh: 有关上述改动的具体内容，请参阅相应的技能和物品说明

lines.en: Item Potency
lines.zh: 物品威力

lines.en: Attacks from heroes (and hero-like units, including illusions) now have an attribute called Item Potency
lines.zh: 英雄（以及类英雄单位，包括幻象）的攻击现在具有一项名为“物品威力”的属性

lines.en: Some properties of items that apply on-hit effects, like Desolator or Eye of Skadi, are now scaled by the attack’s Item Potency
lines.zh: 部分物品会施加击中效果，如黯灭或斯嘉蒂之眼，部分属性会根据攻击的物品威力有所调整

lines.en: The default Item Potency value for an attack is 100%
lines.zh: 攻击的默认物品威力数值为100%

lines.en: When debuffs are applied from multiple sources, whichever source had the highest Item Potency will be used
lines.zh: 当减益效果由多个来源施加，将采用物品威力最高的来源

lines.en: Examples
lines.zh: 示例

lines.en: Any hero attacking with a Tier 4 Evolved Enchantment has +20% Item Potency, so if they have a Desolator the attack would reduce armor by 7.2
lines.zh: 带有4级附魔“进化”的任意英雄攻击时带有+20%物品威力，所以他们拥有黯灭时，攻击会降低7.2点护甲

lines.en: Attacks from Pangolier’s Swashbuckle now have 60% Item Potency, so if he has a Desolator the strikes would reduce armor by 3.6
lines.zh: 石鳞剑士的虚张声势的攻击现在拥有60%物品威力，因此如果他拥有黯灭,，这些攻击会降低3.6点护甲

lines.en: Illusions have a default Item Potency of 20% and can now apply most item on hit effects
lines.zh: 幻象的默认物品威力为20%，现在可以施加大部分物品的击中效果
